cases.adjacent_boundary: Adjacent: only completeness=exact may answer.

cases.adjacent_boundary: Adjacent: not_ready is typed, never a silent fallback or empty result.

cases.adjacent_boundary: Adjacent: instrument failure is distinct from refusal and from exact empty.

cases.adjacent_boundary: Adjacent: exact edits apply only against the exact source they were projected from.

cases.adjacent_boundary: Adjacent: malformed observations degrade to absence, never to authority.

protocol_lifecycle.stale_prior_observation_rule: A stale prior observation proves only that the old subject/plan cannot be reused; it never forces refusal when fresh current re-resolution independently earns a valid rename.
